current_tip_metadata_checks.method: Read-only GitHub branch metadata, complete recursive Git tree metadata grouped by tree OID, and HEAD requests to Contents endpoints pinned to exact commit IDs. No Git blobs, source text, images or media fetched; no repository or deployment mutations.
current_tip_metadata_checks.scope: Current branch tips only. Metadata verifies presence or absence of named paths and known capture directories. This does not clear history, other refs, live deployments, unrecognized inline content or licensing.
current_tip_metadata_checks.priority_file_basis: Five original Lexington project index.html entrypoints, confirmed in retained historical tree metadata. Entire templates/premium subtree is independently checked.
